preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.intro: Language and formats apply to you only. Units are always metric.
preferences.currencySymbolHint: Optional, up to 5 characters. Overrides the symbol shown for the currency.

instance.monthlyDayHint: 1–28, so every month has the day.
